cohort: The study included 80 neonates (40 full-term and 40 preterm) admitted to the NICU.
finding: Neonatal hypoglycemia is more prevalent in preterm infants and is strongly correlated with low birth weight, cesarean delivery, and low Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean section deliveries were significantly associated with hypoglycemia.
gest_age: Full-term and preterm infants based on gestational age
